entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Are we witnessing the greatest technological breakthrough of our time or the end of humanity as we know it? | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

Karen Hao says Silicon Valley's pursuit of AI development is "trying to make humans redundant" - something she believes we should be deeply questioning.

Watch the full 30 with Guyon Espiner interview: https://www.rnz.co.nz/video/30-with-guyon-espiner/season-5/karen-hao
